subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow diagnostic details should OpenClaw show in user-visible channel replies across Discord, webchat, CLI, and auto-reply fallback paths?
rationale: The implementation can use existing token/model/session facts, but exposing session or channel labels, raw identifiers, model names, and token counts is a product and privacy policy choice that automation should not settle.

options.title: Approve redaction-aware diagnostics
options.body: Show safe display labels plus model and token-budget facts through one shared formatter, with raw identifiers redacted or omitted by default.

options.title: Keep details in logs and status
options.body: Preserve generic channel replies and rely on debug logs, status, or diagnostic bundles for operator-level context details.

options.title: Fold into broader context visibility
options.body: Track this under a larger compaction visibility design that also covers warnings, notifications, and recovery UX.

recommendation.title: Approve redaction-aware diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show safe display labels plus model and token-budget facts through one shared formatter, with raw identifiers redacted or omitted by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent trail across the affected runner, auto-reply, and formatter surfaces and already supplied prior review context on this issue.
